mechanics.claim: He automatically attacks the closest nearby sight-visible enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy Lamb has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
mechanics.quote: prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions

mechanics.claim: The effect (and Wolf's attacking) ends immediately if Lamb leaves the area or dies, cutting the zone duration short.
mechanics.quote: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, but ability haste is applied to the remaining cooldown only after the effect ends, so cooldown reduction is not fully realized until the zone ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' applies ability haste to its cooldown post-effect.

mechanics.claim: The Hunter's Vigor heal is not triggered on attacks against structures and wards.
mechanics.quote: ''Hunter's Vigor's'' heal is not triggered on attacks against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.

mechanics.claim: The heal is not triggered if Kindred is at full health.
mechanics.quote: The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
